core_engine_contract: The phase-specialized search remains the optimizer core; the application owns operational semantics, validation, lifecycle, and evidence.
integration_adaptations: static directed-road edge-speed travel-time semantics aligned with FleetRoute dataset and independent validator
hybrid objective aligned to distance_m + 0.25 * route_duration_s
hard-feasible cluster warm-start acceptance/receipt path preserved for app-provided clustering
structured SolverConfig, ClusterWarmStartReceipt, and SavingsWarmStart operational receipts
bounded/sampled convergence telemetry with process-wide monotone global_best_obj and stream_id
validated greedy/compact-fill/savings live-incumbent evidence added without mutating the solver governor or search state
road-mode reverse edge incidence cached once per static graph instead of rebuilt for every source Dijkstra; pair costs remain identical
structured BackendPrep progress receipts expose dense pair preprocessing without changing optimization state or governed search timing
warm-start evidence lines are emitted on their own stderr lines for unambiguous live parsing; search behavior is unchanged
notes: The app does not claim mathematical optimality. Native global-best states are hard-feasibility validated before publication; the app retains an independent final commit certificate and transactional stale-input/evidence gates. Native preparation and governed search use separate watchdog clocks. Routing-context caches and route publication are objective-specific even when the materialized graph is reusable across objective changes.
